answer: Watermark every delivery at its source so a fake cannot borrow work twice. Trigger: a newcomer applies for paid work and locks a 4,400 POA watermark bond, stamping each delivery with an ivory seal derived from its own key. Rule: the seal travels with the work through its whole voyage to the client, and auditors scan the public registry, an oasis of verified marks, for any seal appearing under two names. A reused seal burns both bonds and bars both for three years, so one hundred fakes risk 440,000 POA.
